Subject: Multi-prospect workshop — staggered windows & fallback plan

Hi all,

Thanks for your interest in a short group workshop to walk through Redwood Inference for inference cost/latency optimization. We want to keep this tight (30–45 minutes) and make sure each prospect gets a chance to surface their priority questions.

Proposed approach: we’ll run two staggered windows (same content):
- Window A: Tue Oct 12, 15:00–15:45 PT (focused on infra & routing)
- Window B: Wed Oct 13, 18:00–18:45 PT (late window for APAC overlap)

Please reply with which window you'd prefer, or flag if you need a private follow-up. If you have specific agenda items (SLOs, quantization, or security/compliance), put them in your reply and we’ll slot 5–10 minutes.

Quick logistics: we’ll attach the calendar invite once we confirm the headcount. Deck attached (draft). If either window is oversubscribed we’ll use the fallback plan (shorter interleaved breakout + recorded session) — runbook attached for internal staff.

Poll link: https://forms.gle/quick-poll-demo-windows
Attachments: redwood-workshop-deck-v1.pdf

Thanks,
Rafael

Hello everyone —

Thanks for the quick replies. Finalized plan below (we'll keep the flow tight):

- Window A: Tue Oct 12, 15:00–15:45 PT — confirmed: Scout Metrics (2 attendees), Finlytics (1)
- Window B: Wed Oct 13, 18:00–18:45 PT — confirmed: Atlas Retail (2 attendees)

Logistics:
- Calendar invites attached (redwood-demo-bridge.ics). Please accept the invite you've been added to; if you need to swap windows we can move you but we prefer to avoid last-minute shifts.
- We will record both windows. Recording + short Q&A notes will be shared with all registrants within 24 hours.
- If either window is oversubscribed we will use the fallback plan (Ben's 2-step): shorten live Q&A and provide recording + an optional private 1:1 follow-up.
